entries.da152ad80957b29b: As its basic management policy, it aims to become a “technical information integrated management company” that enables “straight-through processing” through the use of IT technology. Its medium-term management strategy, in parallel with continuous development of existing businesses and strengthening of its management structure, promotes strategic measures aimed at forming a balanced corporate structure, and states that it will pursue sustainable group management, expand business areas in the Technical Information Solutions Business and the Digital Solutions Business, and promote sales activities in the FA Robot Solutions Business. It also cites securing and developing capable personnel on a stable basis as a priority issue to be addressed.

entries.f9ef8c362fc2b9b0: This business consists of the company, SAS SB Traduction, Torindo Co., Ltd. and PMC Co., Ltd., and provides design support for products and equipment using 3D-CAD, consulting based on technical information, and production of various manuals and digital content. The company undertakes 3D-CAD design work and dispatches engineers; SAS SB Traduction in France handles multilingual translation and software localization; Torindo Co., Ltd. handles production of multilingual manuals for IT-related equipment and business equipment and various translations; and PMC Co., Ltd. produces instruction manuals, various manuals, catalogs and others. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥3,485 million.
